name: The Langham, New York, Fifth Avenue
positioning: Fifth Avenue hotel in Midtown Manhattan, a couple of blocks from the Empire State Building, with an art collection and apartment-style suites
best_for: Travelers who want a Midtown base near the Empire State Building
Longer stays and families wanting suites with kitchens and a washer and dryer

facts.text: The hotel is a couple of blocks from the Empire State Building.
Bryant Park and Grand Central Station are several blocks north of the hotel, and the restaurants of Koreatown are just to the south.
The original architects of the building were Gwathmey Siegel.
The hotel was built as The Setai Fifth Avenue in 2010 and joined the Langham Hotels and Resorts collection in 2013.
Two large oil paintings by New York painter Alex Katz hang behind the front desk and are the first in a collection of original artworks displayed throughout the hotel.
The restaurant Ai Fiori serves French- and Italian Riviera-influenced cuisine on the hotel's second floor.
Rooms and suites have DUXIANA mattresses and views of the New York City skyline.
The one-bedroom suites have a washer and dryer, a kitchen with a full fridge, and Empire State Building views.
The Family Room has a large walk-in closet, an oversized marble-clad bathroom and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Fifth Avenue and Midtown Manhattan.
The Langham Club is on the 4th floor and overlooks Fifth Avenue.
The gym has Technogym equipment and weights, a stretching area and on-demand classes.
There is elevator access to all floors and multiple ADA rooms are available.
